title: Investigating the metabolic reprogramming mechanisms in diabetic nephropathy: a comprehensive analysis using bioinformatics and machine learning.
summary: Four machine-learning algorithms combined with WGCNA and protein-interaction analysis identified six metabolic-reprogramming genes associated with diabetic nephropathy across three GEO transcriptome datasets.

evidence.tested: The analysis identified 256 metabolic DEGs and six key genes; ROC analysis supported diagnostic value, and qRT-PCR in human samples confirmed CXCR2, NAMPT and CUEDC2 expression patterns. Dataset integration and observational validation do not establish causality.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
